doc.title: Roswell Rudd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998

title: The pulse of his father's bass drum
summary: His father drummed quarter notes along with the records, audible a hundred yards from the house.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So you kind of had that swing rhythm become a part of you at a young age.
Yeah. Yeah. You could always hear the bass drum throbbing, playing those quarter notes anywhere within a hundred yards of the house. Even if you heard nothing else, you could hear that pulse.
Some things don’t change, because that’s what you hear going down the street these days with the kids in their cars.
The pulse, yeah, yeah. Isn’t it amazing how everything just goes on around that pulse.
